warnings.instrument-id: Instrument ids use lowercase letters, digits and -: “{id}”
warnings.no-section: Bars need a section first, like ## Verse 1
warnings.use-not-found: Can’t find an earlier section named “{name}”
warnings.beats-mismatch: Beats add up to {sum}, but the meter has {beats}
warnings.landmark-too-long: This lyric landmark has {words} words; keep it to {max} or fewer
warnings.unsupported-version: This chart says ChartDown {version}; this parser reads {supported}
warnings.header-not-closed: The header needs a closing --- line
warnings.use-with-rows: @use must be the only content line of a section; its own rows are kept
warnings.layer-no-section: Notes need a section first, like ## Chorus
warnings.layer-line: A layer holds only sections, bar headings and notes
warnings.pickup-and-meter: A bar can’t have both a pickup and a one-bar meter
warnings.pickup-length: A pickup needs more than 0 and fewer than {beats} beats
warnings.pickup-not-first: A pickup must be the first bar of a section
warnings.pickup-beats-mismatch: Beats add up to {sum}, but the pickup has {beats}
warnings.riff-note: Can’t read “{token}” in a riff (notes are scale degrees or letters)
warnings.riff-beats-mismatch: Riff beats add up to {sum}, but its space in the bar is {beats}
warnings.pass-without-repeat: A cue for one pass (like 2x) needs a repeat
warnings.note-pass-without-repeat: An MD note for one pass (like 2x) needs a repeat in its section
warnings.nav-duplicate: There is more than one {mark} mark
warnings.nav-second-jump: A song can have only one D.S. or D.C. jump
warnings.nav-needs-coda: {mark} needs a to-coda mark and a coda mark

hero.title: One song for the whole band. Cues for every player.
hero.lead: ChartDown App turns plain-text Nashville Number charts into band charts on iPad and desktop, with music director notes for each instrument.

write.title: Write it in ChartDown
write.text: Plain text that reads like a chart: sections, bars, numbers, and notes for each instrument.

set.title: Build your set
set.text: Pick the versions you play, set the key for each song and assign every musician an instrument.

play.title: Play from your part
play.text: Everyone sees the same song. Each player sees the cues meant for them.

saved.title: Every change saved
saved.text: Go back to any revision. Sets stay on the version you chose.

offline.title: Offline sets
offline.text: Download a set before you leave. Every chart opens in airplane mode.

stand.title: Stand mode
stand.text: Full screen, big numbers, one tap to the next section.

part.title: Your part only
part.text: Each musician sees the music director's notes for their own instrument.

language.title: ChartDown is an open language
language.text: The notation is public domain (CC0) and lives on GitHub. Write your charts once, keep them as plain text forever, and use them in any app that supports ChartDown.
